analysis.sign_convention: every difference is muon - adamw; a negative delta_nll_diff means that Muon loses less quality under PTQ, a negative abs_nll_diff that its quantized NLL is lower
analysis.t_quantile_note: ci95 uses t_quantile_0p975_df2, the constant fixed by the protocol. The closed form sqrt(2 * 0.9025 / 0.0975) is 1.6e-10 smaller (4e-11 of an interval half-width). p-values use the exact df = 2 formula 1 - |t| / sqrt(t^2 + 2).
analysis.primary_note: Holm-Bonferroni family: the (format, mode) cells with more than one method, each at the method with the lowest pooled val NLL, test endpoints. delta_nll_diff is the primary endpoint; abs_nll_diff is corrected as a separate family.

caveats: At least one Stage B seed has a baseline val NLL gap above the tolerance (max 0.1439 nats).

AdamW val NLL is not monotone in the step count on the pilot seed: 2 trial(s) are worse than a shorter trial by more than the tolerance (worst: 544 steps, LR 0.0015, +0.089 nats). AdamW runs at these LRs have run-to-run instability, which limits how well a seed-0 match transfers to other seeds.

Three paired seeds give 2 degrees of freedom: the 95% interval is 4.30 standard errors wide on each side, and small consistent effects cannot pass a Holm correction. Absence of significance is not evidence of equal PTQ sensitivity.

The iso-loss match is calibrated on seed 0 and then locked. The Stage B baselines of seeds 1 to 3 differ from seed 0, so per-seed baseline gaps can exceed the calibration tolerance; they are reported.
Iso-loss is not iso-compute: AdamW uses 1.70x the training tokens of Muon to reach the same val NLL.
One 50m model family, short training (less than one epoch of a 26M-token set), one calibration set. PTQ sensitivity of longer-trained or larger models can differ.
Hessians come from one forward pass of the full-precision model (parallel GPTQ). Static activation scales are calibrated on the BF16 model, not on the upstream-quantized model.
Dynamic W4A4 activation scales are per forward batch (16 x 512 tokens), so they depend on the batch.
Diagnostics p-values are descriptive and not corrected for multiplicity.
